data.rationale: jcv_floor needs the result to be finite to prove that i - 1.0 is finite when v < i (rte_27)
jcv_ceil needs jcv_real_to_int to return a finite value so that i+1 is finite (for rte_28) and so that the result of jcv_ceil is finite.
jcv_ceil needs to know the relationship between input and output of jcv_real_to_int to prove that result >= v (truncation toward zero for positive values means result <= v).
jcv_ceil needs to know the relationship between input and output of jcv_real_to_int to prove that result >= v (truncation toward zero for negative values means result >= v).
